finding.claim: test_supersede_refusals checks only for a nonzero exit, so an uncaught exception (exit 1 with a traceback) passes as a refusal. It should assert the one-line "refused:" message on stderr, and it does not cover the same-id or missing-index-entry refusals.

fixes.change: Tests for a wrapped entry and a missing index entry; r2 checks the Correction heading carries a date; r5 checks exit 1 and a refused line on stderr, including self-supersede and a non-ASCII digit.
